items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Well, I think it was Boybin Street.

ctx.x: Well, I think it was Boybin Street. Yeah. Near what? Near uh, St. Claude. Now Paul, though.
No, it was Boybin at that time. Yeah, but now Paul, though. It's Paul, but that's right. Now. So, uh, did you grow up here in the city?
Uh, well, uh, say from 12 years up. I was at Phoenix, Louisiana. Uh, at the age around of five years old up until 12 years old. Uh-huh. Uh-huh.
